chapter: A Journey through States of Water
subject: Science
overview: Indha lesson-la water solid ice-aa, liquid water-aa, gas water vapour-aa eppadi irukkum-nu paappom. Heating, cooling, evaporation, condensation, matrum water cycle-ai daily-life examples moolama purinjukkolvom.
learning_objectives: Ice-um liquid water-um ore substance-oda rendu states-nu explain panna mudiyum.
Evaporation nadakkumbodhu water vapour-a maarudhu-nu example-oda solla mudiyum.
Cold surface-la water vapour droplets-aa maaruvadhu condensation-nu identify panna mudiyum.
Solid, liquid, gas-oda shape matrum flow differences-ai compare panna mudiyum.
Heating/cooling nala melting, freezing, evaporation, condensation eppadi nadakkudhu-nu describe panna mudiyum.
Evaporation cooling effect matrum water cycle stages-ai explain panna mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: Ice-um water-um ore substance
teaching_sequence.caption: Oru ice cube-ai cup-la vechu konjam neram observe pannunga. Ice melt aagi liquid water-a maarum. Ice-um water-um vera vera substances illa; rendu perum water-oda different states. Ice fixed shape-la irukkum; water flow aagi container shape edukkum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Shikanji-la irukkura ice melt aaguradhai paarthiruppeenga. Ice enga pochu? Adhu disappear aagala; liquid water-a maariduchu. Ippo solid-um liquid-um eppadi different-nu serndhu paappom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Ice melt aana enna aagum? Ice-um water-um rendu different substances-aa, illa ore water-oda rendu states-aa?

teaching_sequence.title: Puddle yen disappear aagudhu?
teaching_sequence.caption: Mazhai-kku appuram ground-la irukkura puddle konjam konjama kuraiyum. Steel plate-la vecha water-um seep aagama dry aagum. Water liquid state-lirundhu kannukku theriyadha water vapour-aa maarum. Indha process-ku evaporation-nu peru.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Sunny day-la wet clothes seekiram dry aagum; shade-la konjam late aagum. Water enga pogudhu-nu yosippom. Adhu air-kulla water vapour-aa maarudhu; idhudhaan evaporation.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Puddle dry aagumbodhu water enga pogudhu? Evaporation-na enna?

teaching_sequence.title: Condensation: droplets enga irundhu varudhu?
teaching_sequence.caption: Ice water irukkura tumbler-oda veli surface-la tiny droplets form aagum. Tumbler-kulla irundhu water leak aagala. Air-la irukkura water vapour cold glass-ai touch pannumbodhu liquid droplets-aa maarum. Indha change condensation.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Cold tumbler veliya water drops varumbodhu glass leak aagudhu-nu ninaikka vendaam. Air-la irukkura water vapour cold surface-la cool aagi droplets-aa maarudhu.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Cold tumbler veliya droplets form aaguradhukku kaaranam enna? Indha process-oda name enna?

teaching_sequence.title: Solid, liquid, gas compare pannuvom
teaching_sequence.caption: Ice-ku fixed shape irukkum; adhu easy-aa flow aagadhu. Liquid water-ku fixed shape illa; container shape edukkum, aana volume irukkum. Water vapour spread aagi available space-ai fill pannum. Idhu moonu states-oda mukkiya difference.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Oru ice cube, oru tumbler water, water vapour-ai compare pannunga. Edhukku fixed shape irukku? Edhu flow aagum? Edhu room full-aa spread aagum?
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Endha state fixed shape maintain pannum? Liquid-um gas-um eppadi different?

teaching_sequence.title: Heating-um cooling-um state change pannum
teaching_sequence.caption: Ice-ku heat kuduthaa melting nadandhu liquid water aagum. Liquid water freeze aana solid ice aagum. Water heat aagumbodhu evaporation speed adhigamaagalam; water vapour cool aana condensation nadakkum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Freezer-la water ice-a maarudhu; room temperature-la ice melt aagudhu. Heat add pannumbodhu enna change, heat remove pannumbodhu enna change-nu paappom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Melting-na endha state-lirundhu endha state-ku change? Freezing eppadi opposite?

teaching_sequence.title: Evaporation nala cooling
teaching_sequence.caption: Earthen pot-oda chinna pores vazhiya konjam water veliya varum. Andha water evaporate aagumbodhu heat eduthukkollum; adhanaala pot-kulla irukkura water cool-aa irukkum. Wind, temperature, exposed surface area evaporation speed-ai affect pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Matka water summer-la cool-aa irukkum-nu theriyum. Pot surface-la irukkura water evaporate aagumbodhu surroundings-lirundhu heat edukkudhu. Adhanaala remaining water cool aagudhu.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Matka water cool-aa irukka evaporation eppadi help pannudhu? Evaporation speed-ai affect pannura rendu factors sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Clouds, rain, water cycle
teaching_sequence.caption: Sun heat nala river, lake, sea water evaporate aagudhu. Water vapour mela poi cool aagi tiny droplets-aa condense aagum; clouds form aagum. Droplets perusaagi heavy aana rain-aa keezha vizhum. Water thirumba rivers, lakes, sea-kku serudhu; cycle continue aagudhu.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Sea-la irundhu water sky-kku poi, cloud-aagi, rain-aa thirumba varudhu. Idhu one-way trip illa; continuous water cycle. Diagram-la evaporation, condensation, precipitation stages-ai follow pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Cloud form aaguradhukku enna process nadakkanum? Water cycle-la rain-kku appuram water enga pogum?

teaching_sequence.title: Water states recap
teaching_sequence.caption: Ice, liquid water, water vapour moonum ore substance-oda states. Heating/cooling nala state change nadakkum. Evaporation water-ai vapour-a maathum; condensation vapour-ai droplets-a maathum. Nature-la indha changes water cycle-ai nadathudhu.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Ippo ice-lirundhu water, water-lirundhu vapour, vapour-lirundhu droplets varra journey-ai connect pannunga. Oru daily-life example solli ovvoru process-ai explain pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Melting, evaporation, condensation, freezing — indha naangu processes-la ovvorondrukkum oru example sollunga.
